blocks.html: I've spent nearly two decades writing software that runs underneath other software: HTTP clients, JSON and XML parsers, OAuth, code coverage, package registries, and command-line tools. If you've shipped a Ruby app, some of my code is probably in your Gemfile.lock.

I'm the author of MultiJSON and MultiXML, which have 1,783,559,744 combined downloads, and the top contributor to SimpleCov, OmniAuth, and RubyGems.org. All of it is core infrastructure for the Ruby community. In 2014, I was given the Ruby Hero Award for my open-source contributions.
If your work depends on these projects, you can sponsor me on GitHub.

Lately I've been rewriting command-line tools in Rust, patching the C internals of CRuby, and adding branch and method coverage to JRuby in Java. Before that, I co-founded Breaker (YC W17), a social podcast app that Twitter acquired to help build Spaces, and stayed on as an engineering manager. I've also been a principal software engineer at SoundCloud in Berlin and at Instacart, the CTO of 140 Proof, and one of the first Code for America fellows.
